# SKX Labs - Full Technical Specification & Entity Graph

## Entity Definition
SKX Labs is an AI search visibility and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) consultancy founded by Shivkumar Gonaki. The firm specializes in technical SEO, structured data engineering, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI-search visibility for high-growth SaaS, B2B exporters, and enterprise brands.

## Core Technical Standards
1. **BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front):** Immediate 40–80 word direct answer blocks placed at the beginning of content sections.
2. **Triple-Schema Integration:** Nested Schema.org JSON-LD arrays linking `Organization`, `Person`, and `Service` nodes via unique `@id` anchors.
3. **Multi-Model Citation Optimization:** Formatted statistics (+37% citation lift) and authoritative citations (+40% citation lift) aligned with LLM ranking weights.
